newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam coffee exports so far this season 150,000T.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam coffee exports so far this season 150,000T.

text.p: Vietnam's current robusta coffee harvest is almost completed and about 150,000 tonnes of total projected exports of 240,000 tonnes have been shipped to roasters, an official said on Wednesday.

"About 150,000 tonnes has already been exported from Vietnam," Doan Trieu Nhan, chairman of the Vietnam Coffee and Cocoa Association (Vicofa), told Reuters in an interview at an Asia Coffee conference in Ho Chi Minh city.
"By the end of January, the harvesting of the new crop should already be over," he said.
Traders here said the benchmark Vietnam Grade 2, 8.0 percent black and broken, was seen at around US$950 a tonne FOB Saigon for nearby delivery, almost unchanged from the previous week.
The Indonesia grade 4 coffee was quoted by traders here at around $1,150 a tonne FOB Panjang, also little changed from the preceding week.
